blocks.html: Push the drone to any point on the map, orbit a target, or have it follow you, all from the Quick Flight Toolbar without building a route.

slides.title: Open Quick Task
slides.html: Tap a spot on the map to send the drone there. Quick Task opens with the location ready and three options: Cancel, Go Now, Orbit.

slides.title: Fly there now
slides.html: Tap Go Now. The drone takes off if needed and flies to the point, holding its current altitude (HAL, Height Above Launch).

slides.title: Set an exact coordinate
slides.html: For a precise point, tap the Selected Coordinate field and type the grid and altitude. This is more exact than tapping the map.

slides.title: Orbit a target
slides.html: Tap Orbit to circle the point and watch it. A window lets you set the orbit radius and speed; then use the sticks to grow or shrink the circle and reverse direction mid-flight.

slides.title: Follow Me
slides.html: Tap Follow Me in the UAS Tool. The drone locks onto your ATAK GPS self-marker and keeps the same range and bearing as you move.

slides.title: Set the follow distance
slides.html: Long press Follow Me to open a dialog. There you can pick a different marker to follow and set the stand-off distance.
